theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_cp_disjoint_refinement
theorems.statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid P) (Good : ℕ → Euclid m → Prop), MeasurableSet M → (∀ j, IsCompact (C j) ∧ ContinuousOn (ψ j) (C j)) → μ (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' C j) = 0 → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (M ∩ ψ j '' C j)), ∀ y ∈ C j, ψ j y = x → Good j y) → ∃ Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid m), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ Y j ⊆ C j ∧ ψ j '' Y j ⊆ M ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y j, Good j y) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) ∧ μ (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
